extensionDescription.message: The ultimate Roblox enhancement suite with themes, a redesigned sidebar, and quality-of-life features.

onboarding_step1.message: Click the gear icon in the Roblox header, then select "Purpura Settings".

sdbr_messages_desc.message: Adds a Messages button to the sidebar.

sdbr_purpuraSettings_desc.message: Adds a Purpura Settings button to the sidebar.

sdbr_tradeButton_desc.message: Adds a Trade button to the sidebar.

avatarCycler_description.message: Select at least two saved avatars and choose how often Purpura should switch between them.

settings_avatarSearch_desc.message: Add a search bar to the avatar editor to quickly find items by name.

settings_avatarSearch_filtersDesc.message: Adds filters to the avatar search bar: creator name, price range, availability, effects, and limiteds.

settings_bloatwareRemover_desc.message: Removes unnecessary UI elements, sponsored content, and promotional features from Roblox pages.

settings_botDetector_desc.message: Analyzes game servers to detect potential bot activity.

settings_botDetector_roundWholeDesc.message: Round bot percentage to nearest whole number (e.g., '43%' instead of '42.9%')

settings_botDetector_showDatabaseDesc.message: Display a button to view all player thumbnails analyzed during detection

settings_bundleItemViewer_desc.message: On item pages of items inside of a bundle, shows what bundle the item is from.

settings_chatEligibility_desc.message: Shows if you can chat with a friend or haven't done an age check when hovering over the chat button on their profile. Inspired by RoValra's Chat Eligibility Tooltip feature.

settings_friendOrigin_desc.message: Shows where and when you became friends with a user on the friends list.

settings_bulkUnfriend_desc.message: Allows you to bulk unfriend users from the friends list.

settings_mostPlayedTogether_desc.message: Shows which games you and your friends have played together the most.

settings_credit_cjiggy.message: Super important tester who helped make sure everything functioned in the early days of Purpura. He was there since day one, and I am incredibly grateful.

settings_credit_deluxis.message: Another notable tester who made very detailed bug reports and helped crack down on any critical bugs.

settings_credit_valra.message: Huge inspiration during Purpura's development and helped with a lot of the startup support for region-related code.

settings_credits_footer.message: Thank you to everyone who contributed to this project. Join our

settings_credits_subtitle.message: Special thanks to everyone who supported Purpura.

settings_friendsManager_desc.message: Adds a button to the friends page to manage friends in bulk (unfriend/block).

settings_playtime_desc.message: Tracks how long you spend in Roblox games, even when the tab is closed.

settings_playtime_import_desc.message: Bring your RoPro playtime history into Purpura before you disable RoPro.

settings_playtime_import_btnTitle.message: Import your playtime history from RoPro

settings_playtime_import_step1Desc.message: Go to chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, find RoPro and click Service Worker.

settings_playtime_import_step2Desc.message: Paste the script below into the console and press Enter. If prompted, type allow pasting first.

settings_playtime_import_step3Desc.message: Right-click the printed array, pick Copy object, then paste it below and press Import.

settings_playtime_import_gist.message: (or get the script from the Gist Repository)

settings_playtime_import_errNoGames.message: No games found in the data.

settings_playtime_import_errBadId.message: Entry at position $1 has an invalid id.

settings_playtime_import_errNoPlaytime.message: No games with playtime were found in the data.

settings_playtime_import_toast.message: Imported $1 games ($2) from RoPro into your tracker.

settings_gameLauncherWidget_desc.message: A floating search widget to launch any game instantly from any Roblox page.

settings_gameOutfits_desc1.message: View and equip your saved outfits directly from game pages.

settings_gameOutfits_desc2.message: Adds an 'Outfits' tab to the game navigation bar.

settings_gameOutfits_launchPopup.message: Show outfit selector on game launch

settings_gameOutfits_launchPopupDesc.message: Display a popup to change outfit when clicking Play

settings_ghostProfiles_desc.message: Allows you to view banned users profiles.

settings_ghostProfiles_webRequestDesc.message: Required to detect redirected banned user profiles.

settings_greetings_desc.message: Display unique greetings with various rarities when visiting Roblox.

settings_hideDownloadButton_desc.message: Hides the Download button from the Roblox navigation bar.

settings_freeRobloxPlusThemes_desc.message: Allows you to use Roblox Plus themes on the site without Roblox Plus.

frpt_notice.message: Select and use any theme without Roblox Plus.

settings_homePageTweaks_desc.message: Allows you to rearrange and customize the Roblox Home Page by hiding or showing specific sections, and rearranging the order of visible sections.

settings_homePageTweaks_homePageButtonDe.message: Adds a button to the Roblox Home page, allowing you to quickly edit it.

settings_betterContinue_autoRefresh_desc.message: Updates the Continue row after a game launches, without reloading the page.

settings_avatarCycler_desc.message: Cycle through your saved avatars automatically on a customizable interval.

settings_infiniteAvatar_desc.message: Equip up to 10 accessories and up to 10 layered clothing items while customizing your avatar.

settings_itemExplorer_desc.message: Adds an item page explorer for quickly previewing and downloading available item assets.

settings_lastOnline_desc.message: Records when users were last online, only works if they were online once after this was enabled.

settings_noRent_desc.message: Hides all rent options on the catalog.

settings_pageBinds_desc1.message: Create custom keyboard shortcuts to quickly navigate between Roblox pages.

settings_pageBinds_desc2.message: Press the key while on any Roblox page to navigate to the bound URL.

settings_pill_beta_tooltip.message: This feature is in beta, and it may be unstable and cause issues. Use with caution.

settings_pill_experimental_tooltip.message: This feature is experimental and may break at any time. Use with caution.

settings_pill_deprecated_tooltip.message: This feature is deprecated and no longer maintained. It has been disabled.

settings_pinnedGames_desc.message: Bookmark and organize your favorite games for quick access from any Roblox page.

settings_purpuraCursors_desc.message: Customize your cursor with various styles while browsing Roblox. Select a preset below or upload a custom image.

settings_purpuraCursors_trailEffectsDesc.message: Show animated particle effects that follow your cursor movement

settings_purpuraTabs_desc1.message: Customize the browser tab appearance when on Roblox pages.

settings_purpuraTabs_desc2.message: Change the tab title format and favicon icon.

settings_purpurasSelection_desc.message: Adds a curated 'Purpura's Selection' game carousel to the Charts page showcasing hand-picked hidden gems across various genres.

settings_quickPlay_desc.message: Show a play button overlay on game cards on the home page for instant game launching.

settings_quickStatusSwitcher_desc.message: Adds a button to the navbar to quickly change your online status, join settings, privacy options and theme on the fly.

settings_quickStatusSwitcher_themeIntegr.message: Adds your custom themes and Purpura prepackaged themes to the Quick Settings theme setting list. Does nothing without the Theme Editor feature being enabled.

settings_redesignedAvatarEditor_desc.message: Completely redesigns the Roblox Avatar Editor.

settings_remainingRobux_desc.message: Adds back the feature that Roblox removed, displaying your remaining Robux Balance in the purchase confirmation dialog.

settings_reworkedSidebar_desc.message: A complete overhaul of the Roblox sidebar with a more modern and clean look.

settings_roThemer_desc1.message: Customize Roblox's theme with advanced color schemes and styling options.

settings_roThemer_desc2.message: Select a theme below to apply it site-wide.

settings_robloxAgeTheme_desc.message: Switch between different Roblox age theme styles.

settings_robloxAgeTheme_themeDesc.message: Choose which Roblox age theme to apply.

settings_robuxConversations_desc.message: Adds the USD value of the Robux cost in parentheses next to the displayed Robux amount on catalog item pages.

settings_saveLotsRobux_desc1.message: Save 10-60% Robux on any purchase on the Roblox website.

settings_saveLotsRobux_desc2.message: Catalog and bundle purchases estimate 40% savings, and game pass purchases estimate 10% savings.

settings_saveLotsRobux_placeIdDesc.message: Place ID used when launching an experience for the Robux Saver purchase flow.

slr_setup_warning_text.message: The group owner cannot be the same account you are buying items with. Use a secured alt account with 2FA enabled and a strong, unique password.

slr_setup_step1.message: Create a group on your alt account.

slr_setup_step2.message: In Roblox Studio (logged into the alt), create a new Baseplate.

slr_setup_step3.message: Insert a Script in ServerScriptService named PurpuraPurchaseHandler.

slr_setup_step4.message: Paste the Lua code below into that script.

slr_setup_step5.message: In Game Settings > Monetization, enable Third-Party Sales.

slr_setup_step6.message: Publish to Roblox under your group.

slr_setup_step7.message: Copy the Place ID from the URL and enter it in the settings for Robux Saver.

slr_setup_payouts_text.message: Only the group owner account can pay out saved Robux.

slr_setup_pending_text.message: Funds are pending for approximately one month before payout.

settings_serverInfo_desc.message: Shows game server information such as ping, region, and FPS on game pages.

settings_statusSpoofer_desc.message: Spoof your online status to either appear offline or show as being in Studio.

settings_statusSpoofer_note.message: **Note:** It can take up to 5 minutes to update, and you must keep the tab open for as long as you want the spoof to persist.

settings_streamerMode_desc.message: Hide sensitive information like your username, Robux balance, email, and phone. Best used when streaming or recording.

settings_blurSerialNumbers_desc.message: Hide limited item serial numbers on trade pages.

settings_disableVideoAutoplay_desc.message: Stops videos from autoplaying on the Roblox website.

settings_tabs_titleHint.message: Use {title} for the page title, {n} for notifications icon. Example: "{title} ⋅ Purpura {n}"

settings_theme_pasteHint.message: Paste your theme CSS below. Include a manifest comment at the top:

settings_uncorporatify_desc.message: Restore the classic Roblox look by renaming corporate terms to user-friendly names.

settings_unpendingRobux_desc1.message: Shows an estimate of how many pending Robux will stop pending within 24 hours.

settings_unpendingRobux_desc2.message: May be inaccurate and can take longer on accounts with large transaction history.

settings_totalSpent_desc.message: Adds a "lifetime transactions" section to the transaction page showing you how much Robux you have spent and earned across your account's transaction history Also calculates net gained/lost.

store_supportDesc.message: Your support funds development and keeps features free for everyone. Select an amount below.

unpending_insufficientTooltip.message: Not enough transaction history to make an accurate estimate. Please wait for more transactions to complete.

unpending_tooltip.message: This is an estimate of how many Robux from your pending balance will become available tomorrow, based on your transaction data. The actual amount may vary and may be inaccurate.

settings_r6WarningRemover_desc.message: Removes the R6 Warning banner when switching from R15 to R6.

settings_priceFloor_desc.message: Shows the price floor of items and if said items are at the price floor.

priceFloor_description.message: The minimum price this item can be listed for. Roblox adjusts it based on the item type and configuration.

settings_offsaleLegacyPrices_desc.message: Shows the last-sale price of an offsale item.

settings_enhancedSearch_desc.message: Press '/' to focus the search box and get autocomplete results for users, friends and experiences directly in the dropdown.

settings_enhancedSearch_userSearchDesc.message: Shows an exact matching user in the search dropdown.

settings_enhancedSearch_gameSearchDesc.message: Shows the best matching experience in the search dropdown.

settings_enhancedSearch_friendSearchDesc.message: Shows matching friends in the search dropdown.

settings_enhancedSearch_focusKeyDesc.message: Press '/' to focus the search box.
